meta.source: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural Vectors, Admin 1 – States, Provinces (v5.x, ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces) via github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector
meta.license: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/)
meta.projection: Lambert conformal conic, standard parallels 37.5N/40.5N, central meridian 35E; x = east, y = north
meta.units: map width = 1000 for mainland Turkey (the 81 provinces span x -500..500); scale and origin are fixed by the mainland only and did not change when KKTC was added. KKTC (plate 82) uses the same transform and lies inside the mainland x-range, so bounds only grew in -y.
meta.ids: plate = internal numeric id (1-81 official plate codes, 82 = KKTC). code = label to draw and the word viewers type ("06", "34", "KKTC"). joinByNumber = whether typing the number joins (false for KKTC).
meta.seaNeighbors: extra links across the sea (symmetric, sorted); only KKTC <-> 07 Antalya, 31 Hatay, 33 Mersin. neighbors stays land-only.
meta.kktcSource: Natural Earth admin-1 unit adm0_a3 = CYN ("Northern Cyprus"), one merged region, not simplified
meta.winding: outer rings counter-clockwise, holes clockwise (x east, y north); rings are not closed (last point != first)
meta.simplification: topology-preserving Visvalingam (topojson-simplify) on shared arcs; detached islets < 4 units^2 dropped
meta.neighbors: regions sharing a land border (shared topology arc); symmetric, sorted
